releases.notes:
[**antlmao1337**](https://github.com/antlmao1337)
- Hypixel ban checker with no-rank IP-ban protection (safe skips, rank lookup, proxy support)
- LiquidProxy SOCKS5/HTTP credentials and route joins
- Checker dump import splitting and live session swap
- Bulk cookie/token import from config/cookieias/import
- Quieter logs and config reload without restart

[**naczo5**](https://github.com/naczo5)
- fix multiplayer buttons appearing in random places
- 26.3 support alongside 26.2 and 1.21.11
- 1.8.9 parity: bulk import, Hypixel check screen, shared cookie parser fixes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/naczo5/Account-Switcher-with-Cookies/compare/3.2...3.3

• in-game skin changer and profile manager
• skin previews on account list entries
• multi-file selection in file dialog
• account metadata and rate limiter fixes
